column1: En bag romba heavy ah irukku
column2: Bag-la innaikku thevaiyaana porul mattum vechukko. Mathadha eduthudu.
Dosai pannalaam. Chutney irundha lunch ready.
Paragraph anuppu. Rendu varila surukki tharen.
Ippo konjam thanni kudi. Bottle-a kannukku theriyura idathula vai.
Pannalaam. Endha role-ku interview? Adhukku etha mudhal kelviya kekkuren.
Brightness-a kuraichu paaru. Battery settings-la endha app adhigama use pannudhunnu check pannu.
Mazhai adhigama irundha konjam kaathiru. Pogave vendiyirundha kudai eduthuko.
Unakku enna pidikkum? Varaivadhu, paattu, illa samayal-la irundhu onna therndhedukalaam.
